payload.content: A responsive WordPress site for Kirpal Advocatuur turns three legal practice areas into a calm, approachable journey from legal question to relevant information and contact.
payload.description_1: Employment law, personal injury and contract law needed to feel distinct without burying visitors in dense legal copy. The harder balance was credibility: the site had to feel authoritative and trustworthy while remaining personal, readable and straightforward across screen sizes.
payload.description_2: I separated the three practice areas into distinct service routes, tightened the content hierarchy and kept contact actions close to the relevant legal information. A restrained visual style supports the firm’s professional character, while responsive layouts keep navigation and service content consistent across desktop, tablet and mobile.
